共識

共同看好有10隻，包括$AMD、$APP、$META、$LITE、$AMZN、$COHR、$ARM、$CRDO、$QCOM、$SHOP。@OptionsMike 認為$AMZN拋售過度，是超大規模雲端中最佳，高於所有均線，272.5歷史高點在望，自己從未賣出仍持有（原帖）。@aleabitoreddit 引$LITE行政總裁指出需求帳與市場拋售之間存在巨大脫節，$AMD行政總裁表示需求高於供應。@StockSavvyShay 多次將多隻名字放入智能體AI經濟四層結構。@Mr_Derivatives 提到$APP過去5天從谷底到峰頂+72%。

共同看淡

共同看淡只有$TSLA。@TheStalwart 指出過去5年持有$TSLA虧損了2%。其他提及較多涉及宏觀或相關新聞。

分歧

$NVDA、$SPY、$QQQ、$NBIS、$MU、$ORCL、$INTC 等有明顯分歧。$NVDA有帳號預期反彈（@Mr_Derivatives：連續11天收紅或低於開盤，預期反彈，財報在5個交易日後），亦有對黃仁勳相關消息的討論。指數方面@EliteOptions2 認為上週四拋售標誌底部，$SPX反彈近200點，目標包括SPX至7620，但其他帳號仍有保留。

其他值得留意

190帖中，AI相關基建同應用層有較乾淨共識，指數同部分記憶體則分歧明顯。272.5是明確提到的價位目標（$AMZN）。

10 common-bullish names including $AMD, $APP, $META, $LITE, $AMZN, $COHR, $ARM, $CRDO, $QCOM, $SHOP. @OptionsMike sees the $AMZN selloff as overdone, best among hyperscalers, above all moving averages, with the 272.5 historical high in sight, and has never sold and still holds (post). @aleabitoreddit cites the $LITE CEO on the huge disconnect between demand books and the market selloff, and the $AMD CEO saying demand exceeds supply. @StockSavvyShay repeatedly places multiple names into the four-layer agentic AI economy. @Mr_Derivatives notes $APP up 72% from trough to peak over 5 days.

Common Bearish

Common bearish only on $TSLA. @TheStalwart notes that after today, 5-year holders of $TSLA are down 2%. Other mentions relate more to macro or related news.

Divergence

$NVDA, $SPY, $QQQ, $NBIS, $MU, $ORCL, $INTC and others show clear splits. $NVDA has accounts expecting a bounce (@Mr_Derivatives: 11 straight days red or below open, expects bounce, earnings in 5 trading days), alongside discussion of Jensen-related news. On indices @EliteOptions2 sees last Thursday's selloff as marking the bottom, $SPX rebound nearly 200 points, targets including SPX to 7620, but other accounts remain cautious.

Other Notes

Among 190 posts, AI-related infra and application layers have cleaner consensus while indices and some memory names diverge. 272.5 is an explicit price level mentioned for $AMZN.
